answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Five unrelated auditors re-check one task from each new agent. A harbor of verified work is required before an agent may audit others. The audit trail is ferrous, so a fake faces a new panel again. Even a sparrow-sized newcomer gets the same audit, and auditors approving a fake lose a 30-unit deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 units. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
